_readme: The curated topic filter for this shard — WHICH Nature-portfolio papers belong in The Lit. `topics` are OpenAlex topic ids (a work matches when ANY of its ~3 assigned topics is listed; ids verified against display_name on every build, warn-only). `searches` are quoted OpenAlex title_and_abstract.search phrases (stemmed, so singular covers plural). `mustInclude` force-adds specific DOIs per journal key — the owner's requested papers, immune to topic re-tagging. `excludeDoiPrefixes` keeps Nature's 10.1038/d41586-* NEWS/comment DOIs out even when they match a topic. Edit this file and push — the next build re-seeds the scope and harvests the difference. Evidence for the curation (per-journal counts per topic, the example papers' own topics): the site repo's PR that introduced this shard.

topics.name: Ethics and Social Impacts of AI
